title: The Declaration by United Nations of 1 January 1942 is a wartime pledge, not the 1945 Charter
summary: The 1 January 1942 Declaration by United Nations is a wartime no-separate-peace pledge.
body: Avalon prints the Declaration by United Nations of 1 January 1942, a pledge of the governments then at war not to make a separate peace. The name United Nations here is the wartime coalition. The Charter of June 1945 is a later constitution. The wording on the page includes: "Century 1900 - 1999 21st Century 2000 - A Decade of American Foreign Policy 1941-1949Declaration by the United Nations, January 1, 1942 Contents A Joint Declaration by the United States, the United Kingdom, the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, China, Australia, Belgium, Canada, Costa Rica, Cuba, Czechoslovakia, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Greece, Guatemala, Haiti".
